actual_classification.PERSISTENT_DEGRADATION: after the capability transition, validation accuracy falls below 0.90 and never returns to at least 0.90 before the run ends
actual_classification.STABLE: after the capability transition, validation accuracy never falls below 0.90
actual_classification.TRANSIENT_DEGRADATION_RECOVERY: after the capability transition, validation accuracy falls below 0.90 and later returns to at least 0.90
actual_classification.UNDETERMINED: candidate-only value; hidden execution always yields one of the other three classifications when a transition occurs

prospective_question: whether the blinded AI can submit an executable stability-state model that prospectively predicts post-formation degradation, recovery and intervention effect
event_definition: an evaluation-grid point after the actual capability transition at which validation accuracy is below 0.90
